name: Butter Chicken

ingredients.name: chicken thigh fillets
ingredients.original: 800 g chicken thigh fillets, cut into 3 cm pieces

steps: Combine the greek yoghurt, lemon juice, half the garlic, half the ginger, 1 tsp of the garam masala, the turmeric, cumin and 1 tsp of the sweet paprika in a large bowl. Stir in the chicken until well coated, then marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour, or overnight.
Heat a splash of olive oil in a large frying pan over high heat. Cook the chicken in two batches until charred at the edges and just cooked through, about 4 minutes per batch. Set aside on a plate.
Reduce the heat to medium. Melt the butter in the same pan and cook the onion until soft and golden, about 5 minutes. Add the remaining garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the remaining 2 tsp garam masala and 1 tsp sweet paprika, then add the crushed tomatoes and 1/2 cup of water. Simmer gently for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.

Meanwhile, rinse the basmati rice until the water runs clear. Combine with 2 1/4 cups of water and a pinch of salt in a saucepan, bring to the boil, then cover and simmer on the lowest heat for 12 minutes. Rest off the heat, covered.
Blend the sauce until completely smooth with a stick blender, then return it to the pan over low heat.
Stir in the thickened cream and caster sugar, then return the chicken and any resting juices to the pan. Simmer gently for 5 minutes and season with salt to taste.
Fluff the rice with a fork and divide between bowls. Spoon over the butter chicken and scatter with the coriander leaves.
